reason: Confirmed final close for Tuesday 2026-07-14 Strait-of-Hormuz sell-off (supersedes prior intraday/delayed-quote reads flagged earlier this cycle): Express Tribune reports KSE-100 closed at 173,518.82, down 6,408.23 points (-3.56%) from Monday's close of 179,927.05; volume 912.6m shares, value Rs45.6bn, 498 companies traded (40 up, 439 down, 19 unchanged). Driver unchanged: US reinstated a naval blockade of Iranian shipping through the Strait of Hormuz effective Jul 14 plus a 20% fee on cargo transiting the strait; oil at multi-week highs.
